description.summary: You direct your magic into guiding and enhancing your physical attacks
description.value: You direct your magic into guiding and enhancing your physical attacks. For the duration of the spell, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and +2 to damage rolls with any weapon, unarmed strike, or natural attacks. Additionally, they now count as magical attacks for the duration of the spell. This spell does not work with power weapons . This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for June 2021 by Drage Enzeru.
